text: The graveyard now shows Elsa and Batman left as Villagers. Nothing else changed overnight. I ask Hermione: on Cycle 1 you forecasted the Detective would act before the vote, yet Compact clause 5 states the Doctor’s and Detective’s first acts come after tonight’s vote—what correction do you offer?

Hermione, you forecasted the Detective would act before the vote on Cycle 1, yet Compact clause 5 is plain: “the Doctor’s and Detective’s first acts come only after tonight’s vote.” The graveyard now confirms no power role acted before the vote—nothing changed overnight. Your Cycle 1 claim stands contradicted by both rule and result.

I asked you this morning for correction; you provided none. The bazaar keeps a ledger—your words, your votes, the graveyard reveal. When I pressed you, you did not address the contradiction or quote clause 5 back to explain how it was bent. Instead you asked others to name a silent roster member, a deflection.

Now the tea bell nears: state plainly whether you retract your forecast or explain the clause’s bending before the vote.
